# pgLantern docs

The documentation site for [pgLantern](https://pglantern.com), served at
**https://docs.pglantern.com**. Astro + Starlight, with the API reference generated by
`starlight-openapi` from the committed spec snapshot at `src/openapi/pglantern.json`.
Regenerate it from the parent repo with `mix openapi.snapshot`; the parent's `mix test`
fails when the snapshot drifts from the live spec.

Writing docs? Read [docs/authoring.md](docs/authoring.md) first — voice, file layout, and
the validated-example annotation format. Every `curl`/`lantern` example must be validated;
unannotated command blocks fail the build.

## Structure

```
src/content/docs/   the pages — .md/.mdx, routed by filename
src/openapi/        committed OpenAPI snapshot; the API reference is generated from it
src/routeData.ts    injects the site-wide "under construction" banner
public/             copied verbatim into dist/ — favicon, _headers, robots.txt
scripts/            validate-examples.mjs, the example harness
```

## Commands

| Command                   | Action                                                             |
| :------------------------ | :----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `npm install`             | Install dependencies                                               |
| `npm run dev`             | Dev server at `localhost:4321`                                     |
| `npm run build`           | Build to `./dist/` (runs `prebuild` → example validation)          |
| `npm run preview`         | Preview the build locally                                          |
| `npm run examples:check`  | Validate command examples (needs `DOCS_API_BASE` + `DOCS_API_KEY`) |
| `npm run examples:update` | Re-capture the `output=` blocks in place                           |

`npm run build` will fail on its own unless `DOCS_API_BASE` and `DOCS_API_KEY` point at a
server backed by the frozen docs corpus. In the parent repo that is what
`scripts/docs-validate.sh check` sets up; run the build through it, or use
`--ignore-scripts` to skip the `prebuild` hook when you only want the HTML.

## How this deploys

This repo is **not** built by Cloudflare. It is built and uploaded from the parent
(`pgml-api`) repo's Ansible deploy:

```sh
ansible-playbook deploy.yml --tags docs
```

which validates the examples on the control machine, builds `dist/` in a `node:22`
container, and uploads it with `wrangler pages deploy` to the Cloudflare Pages project that
serves `docs.pglantern.com`. One-time Cloudflare setup lives in that repo's
`ansible/docs-site.yml`.

There is no Cloudflare-side build **and there cannot be one**: example validation needs the
time-locked `horton_docs` corpus database and a running Phoenix server, which only exist on
the control machine. That is also why `wrangler` is a devDependency here — it is invoked
from inside the build container, so its version is pinned by `package-lock.json`.

### `public/_headers` and `public/robots.txt`

`_headers` reproduces the security headers Caddy used to add when it served this host
(`ansible/templates/caddy.j2`'s `hardening` snippet). `robots.txt` declares the AI-crawler
opt-out and points at the sitemap. Both are Pages conventions and must live in `public/` so
Astro copies them into the build output, which is what Pages parses.
